```{r}
#GENERATION DES DONNEES AVEC LA FONCTION GENERATE PARTIE 2.1
generate.lm <- function(n = 100, p = 10, p0 = 3, sigma = 1, rho = 0) {
  # 1. Matrice de covariance des prédicteurs
  SigmaX <- matrix(rho, nrow = p, ncol = p)
  diag(SigmaX) <- 1
  
  # 2. Génération des prédicteurs X ~ N(0, SigmaX)
  if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Le package MASS doit être installé : install.packages('MASS')")
  }
  X <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = n, mu = rep(0, p), Sigma = SigmaX)
  
  # 3. Définition du vecteur des coefficients vrais
  beta_star <- c(runif(p0, 1, 2), rep(0, p - p0))
  
  # 4. Génération de l’erreur et de Y
  eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sigma)
  Y <- X %*% beta_star + eps
  
  # 5. Retourner toutes les composantes utiles
  return(list(X = X, Y = as.vector(Y), beta_star = beta_star, SigmaX = SigmaX))
}

```

```{r}
# PARTIE 2.2
# Dépendance par blocs
# ---- Dépendance nécessaire ----

library(mvtnorm)

# Répartition 1..p en K blocs 
.make_blocks <- function(p, K) {
  if (K < 1 || K > p) stop("K doit être entre 1 et p.")
  sizes <- rep(floor(p / K), K)
  sizes[seq_len(p %% K)] <- sizes[seq_len(p %% K)] + 1
  split(seq_len(p), rep(seq_len(K), times = sizes))
}

# Matrice de covariance par blocs :
# s ii = 1
# s ij = rho si i≠j et i, j dans le même bloc
# s ij = 0 sinon
.make_sigma_bloc <- function(p, K, rho) {
  if (rho < 0 || rho >= 1) stop("rho doit être dans [0,1).")
  blocks <- .make_blocks(p, K)
  Sigma <- matrix(0, p, p)
  diag(Sigma) <- 1
  for (b in blocks) {
    if (length(b) > 1) {
      Sigma[b, b] <- rho           # intra-bloc = rho
      diag(Sigma)[b] <- 1          # on remet 1 sur la diagonale
    }
  }
  Sigma
}

# Génération du modèle linéaire avec dépendance par blocs
# - n : nombre d'observations
# - p : nombre total de prédicteurs
# - p0 : nb de coefficients non nuls
# - sigma2 : variance du bruit
# - rho : corrélation intra-bloc
# - K : nombre de blocs
generate.lm.bloc <- function(n, p, p0, sigma2, rho, K) {
  if (p0 > p) stop("p0 doit être <= p.")
  
  # 1) S_X par blocs
  sigmaMatrix <- .make_sigma_bloc(p, K, rho)
  
  # 2) Prédicteurs X ~ N(0, S_X)
  X <- rmvnorm(n = n, mean = rep(0, p), sigma = sigmaMatrix)
  
  # 3) Vrais coefficients beta : p0 non nuls 
  mags  <- runif(p0, 1, 2)
  signs <- sample(c(-1, 1), p0, replace = TRUE)
  beta  <- rep(0, p)
  beta[sample.int(p, p0)] <- mags * signs
  
  # 4) Réponse Y = X beta + E,  E ~ N(0, sigma2 I)
  eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma2))
  y   <- as.vector(X %*% beta + eps)
  
  # 5) Sortie demandée en 2.2 (sans train/test)
  list(y = y, X = X, beta = beta, sigmaMatrix = sigmaMatrix)
}


```

```{r}
# PARTIE 2.3
#  :
# .make_blocks(p, K)
# .make_sigma_bloc(p, K, rho)

.split_train_test <- function(X, y, n.train, n.test) {
  n <- n.train + n.test
  idx <- sample.int(n, n)
  itrain <- idx[seq_len(n.train)]
  itest  <- idx[(n.train + 1):n]
  list(
    train = list(X = X[itrain, , drop = FALSE], y = y[itrain]),
    test  = list(X = X[itest , , drop = FALSE], y = y[itest ])
  )
}


generate.lm.bloc <- function(n.train, p, p0, sigma2, rho, K, n.test = 10 * n.train) {
  n <- n.train + n.test
  
  sigmaMatrix <- .make_sigma_bloc(p, K, rho)
  X <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(n = n, mean = rep(0, p), sigma = sigmaMatrix)
  
  mags  <- runif(p0, 1, 2)
  signs <- sample(c(-1, 1), p0, replace = TRUE)
  beta  <- rep(0, p)
  beta[sample.int(p, p0)] <- mags * signs
  
  eps <- rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(sigma2))
  y   <- as.vector(X %*% beta + eps)
  
  st <- .split_train_test(X, y, n.train, n.test)
  
  list(
    y = y, X = X, beta = beta, sigmaMatrix = sigmaMatrix,
    rho = rho, K = K,
    train = st$train, test = st$test
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 2.4 IMPLEMENTATION DES METHODES
library(leaps)
library(MASS)
# ----- utilitaires communs -----
.mk_df <- function(X, y) {
  df <- data.frame(Y = y, X)
  colnames(df) <- c("Y", paste0("X", seq_len(ncol(X))))
  df
}

# transforme un objet lm en vecteur beta_hat de longueur p (0 si var absente)
.lm_to_beta <- function(fit, p) {
  b <- rep(0, p)
  nm <- names(coef(fit))
  if (length(nm) > 1) {
    keeps <- nm[-1]
    idx <- as.integer(sub("^X", "", keeps))
    b[idx] <- coef(fit)[-1]
  }
  b
}


# Cp 
getBestSubset_Cp <- function(X, y, nvmax = ncol(X)) {
  df <- .mk_df(X, y)
  rs <- regsubsets(Y ~ ., data = df, nvmax = nvmax, really.big=TRUE)            # Leaps & Bounds
  sm <- summary(rs)
  which_mat <- sm$which                                         # (Intercept, X1..Xp)
  best_row <- which.min(sm$cp)                                  # min Cp
  keep <- which_mat[best_row, -1]                               # sans intercept
  form <- if (!any(keep)) Y ~ 1 else as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste0("X", which(keep), collapse = "+")))
  fit <- lm(form, data = df)
  .lm_to_beta(fit, ncol(X))
}

# AIC / BIC — on refit un lm pour chaque ligne du tableau 'which'
getBestSubset_IC <- function(X, y, ic = c("AIC","BIC"), nvmax = ncol(X)) {
  ic <- match.arg(ic)
  df <- .mk_df(X, y)
  rs <- regsubsets(Y ~ ., data = df, nvmax = nvmax, really.big= TRUE)
  sm <- summary(rs)
  which_mat <- sm$which

  scores <- apply(which_mat, 1, function(row_keep) {
    keep <- row_keep[-1]
    form <- if (!any(keep)) Y ~ 1 else as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste0("X", which(keep), collapse = "+")))
    fit <- lm(form, data = df)
    if (ic == "AIC") AIC(fit) else BIC(fit)
  })

  best_row <- which.min(scores)
  keep <- which_mat[best_row, -1]
  form <- if (!any(keep)) Y ~ 1 else as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste0("X", which(keep), collapse = "+")))
  fit <- lm(form, data = df)
  .lm_to_beta(fit, ncol(X))
}

# façade unique
getBestSubset <- function(X, y, criterion = c("Cp","AIC","BIC"), nvmax = ncol(X)) {
  criterion <- match.arg(criterion)
  switch(criterion,
         "Cp"  = getBestSubset_Cp(X, y, nvmax),
         "AIC" = getBestSubset_IC(X, y, "AIC", nvmax),
         "BIC" = getBestSubset_IC(X, y, "BIC", nvmax))
}
# métriques
pred <- function(X, b) as.vector(X %*% b)
rmse <- function(y, yhat) sqrt(mean((y - yhat)^2))
TP <- function(bhat, bstar) sum((bhat != 0) & (bstar != 0))
FP <- function(bhat, bstar) sum((bhat != 0) & (bstar == 0))
```

```{r}
# Fonction pour calculer Cp, AIC et BIC selon la taille du modèle
get_scores <- function(X, y, nvmax = ncol(X)) {
  df <- data.frame(Y = y, X)
  colnames(df) <- c("Y", paste0("X", 1:ncol(X)))

  rs <- regsubsets(Y ~ ., data = df, nvmax = nvmax)
  sm <- summary(rs)
  which_mat <- sm$which

  # Cp direct
  Cp <- sm$cp

  # AIC et BIC : 
  get_ic <- function(fun) {
    apply(which_mat, 1, function(row_keep) {
      keep <- row_keep[-1]
      form <- if (!any(keep)) stats::as.formula("Y ~ 1") else
        stats::reformulate(paste0("X", which(keep)), response = "Y")
      fit <- stats::lm(form, data = df)
      fun(fit)
    })
  }

  AICv <- get_ic(stats::AIC)
  BICv <- get_ic(stats::BIC)

  data.frame(
    Taille = seq_len(nrow(which_mat)),
    Cp  = Cp,
    AIC = AICv,
    BIC = BICv
  )
}

# Jeu d'entraînement
Xtr <- sim_blk$train$X
ytr <- sim_blk$train$y

# Calcul des scores

# Graphique Cp

     type = "b", col = "red2", pch = 19, lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Taille du modèle (k)", ylab = "Critère Cp",
     main = "Recherche exhaustive — Critère Cp")
points(scores$Taille, scores$Cp, pch = 20, col = "gray40", cex = 1)

legend("topright", legend = sprintf("min Cp: k = %d", which.min(scores$Cp)),
       col = "blue", pch = 19, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
# 3. Comparaison des modèles 

# 3.1 EVALUATION DES PERFORMANCES 

## Monte-Carlo : protocole d'évaluation

# 1) 
run_one <- function(seed,
                    n.train, p, p0, sigma2, rho, K, n.test = 10 * n.train) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  sim <- generate.lm.bloc(n.train = n.train, p = p, p0 = p0,
                          sigma2 = sigma2, rho = rho, K = K, n.test = n.test)

  Xtr <- sim$train$X; ytr <- sim$train$y
  Xte <- sim$test$X;  yte <- sim$test$y
  bstar <- sim$beta

  # Estimations best-subset
  b_cp  <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "Cp")
  b_aic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "AIC")
  b_bic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "BIC")

  # Métriques test
  data.frame(
    Methode = c("Cp","AIC","BIC"),
    RMSE    = c(rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_cp)),
                rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_aic)),
                rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_bic))),
    Taille  = c(sum(b_cp!=0), sum(b_aic!=0), sum(b_bic!=0)),
    TP      = c(TP(b_cp, bstar), TP(b_aic, bstar), TP(b_bic, bstar)),
    FP      = c(FP(b_cp, bstar), FP(b_aic, bstar), FP(b_bic, bstar))
  )
}

# 2) Boucle Monte-Carlo 
mc_bestsubset <- function(B = 100,
                          n.train, p, p0, sigma2, rho, K, n.test = 10 * n.train,
                          seed0 = 123) {
  # exécute B répétitions avec des seeds différentes 
  res_list <- vector("list", B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    res_list[[b]] <- try(
      run_one(seed = seed0 + b - 1, n.train=n.train, p=p, p0=p0,
              sigma2=sigma2, rho=rho, K=K, n.test=n.test),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    # 
    if (inherits(res_list[[b]], "try-error")) res_list[[b]] <- NULL
  }
  res_all <- do.call(rbind, res_list)

  # Résumé par méthode : moyenne et sd
  agg_mean <- aggregate(cbind(RMSE, Taille, TP, FP) ~ Methode,
                        data = res_all, FUN = mean)
  agg_sd   <- aggregate(cbind(RMSE, Taille, TP, FP) ~ Methode,
                        data = res_all, FUN = sd)
  names(agg_sd)[-1] <- paste0(names(agg_sd)[-1], "_sd")

  summary_tab <- merge(agg_mean, agg_sd, by = "Methode", sort = FALSE)
  list(raw = res_all, summary = summary_tab)
}

# 3) Exemple : lance une expérience
set.seed(42)
mc <- mc_bestsubset(
  B = 100,
  n.train = 120, p = 12, p0 = 4,
  sigma2 = 1.5, rho = 0.6, K = 3,
  n.test = 1000
)

# Résultats bruts (100*3 lignes) et résumé par méthode
head(mc$raw)
mc$summary

```

```{r}
# 3.2 Planning des situations
## Monte-Carlo multi-scénarios (rho, sigma2) 

# Une répétition pour un scénario 
.run_one <- function(seed, n.train, p, p0, sigma2, rho, K, n.test = 10 * n.train) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  sim <- generate.lm.bloc(n.train = n.train, p = p, p0 = p0,
                          sigma2 = sigma2, rho = rho, K = K, n.test = n.test)
  Xtr <- sim$train$X; ytr <- sim$train$y
  Xte <- sim$test$X;  yte <- sim$test$y
  bstar <- sim$beta

  b_cp  <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "Cp")
  b_aic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "AIC")
  b_bic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "BIC")

  data.frame(
    Methode = c("Cp","AIC","BIC"),
    RMSE    = c(rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_cp)),
                rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_aic)),
                rmse(yte, pred(Xte, b_bic))),
    Taille  = c(sum(b_cp!=0), sum(b_aic!=0), sum(b_bic!=0)),
    TP      = c(TP(b_cp, bstar), TP(b_aic, bstar), TP(b_bic, bstar)),
    FP      = c(FP(b_cp, bstar), FP(b_aic, bstar), FP(b_bic, bstar))
  )
}

# Monte-Carlo sur une grille rho x sigma2
mc_grid_bestsubset <- function(B = 100,
                               n.train, p, p0, K,
                               rhos = c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9),
                               sigma2s = c(0.5, 1, 2),
                               n.test = 10 * n.train,
                               seed0 = 123) {
  res <- list()
  cnt <- 1
  for (rho in rhos) {
    for (sigma2 in sigma2s) {
      runs <- vector("list", B)
      for (b in seq_len(B)) {
        runs[[b]] <- .run_one(seed = seed0 + b - 1, n.train=n.train, p=p, p0=p0,
                              sigma2=sigma2, rho=rho, K=K, n.test=n.test)
      }
      runs_df <- do.call(rbind, runs)
      runs_df$rho <- rho
      runs_df$sigma2 <- sigma2
      res[[cnt]] <- runs_df
      cnt <- cnt + 1
    }
  }
  raw <- do.call(rbind, res)

  # Résumé par (Méthode, rho, sigma2)
  agg_mean <- aggregate(cbind(RMSE, Taille, TP, FP) ~ Methode + rho + sigma2,
                        data = raw, FUN = mean)
  agg_sd   <- aggregate(cbind(RMSE, Taille, TP, FP) ~ Methode + rho + sigma2,
                        data = raw, FUN = sd)
  names(agg_sd)[-(1:3)] <- paste0(names(agg_sd)[-(1:3)], "_sd")

  summary_tab <- merge(agg_mean, agg_sd, by = c("Methode","rho","sigma2"), sort = FALSE)
  list(raw = raw, summary = summary_tab)
}

```

```{r}
# i = identifiant de simulation
getOneSimu <- function(i,
                       n.train = 100, p = 50, p0 = 10,
                       sigma2 = 1, rho = 0.6, K = 5,
                       n.test = 10 * n.train) {
  sim <- generate.lm.bloc(n.train = n.train, p = p, p0 = p0,
                          sigma2 = sigma2, rho = rho, K = K, n.test = n.test)
  Xtr <- sim$train$X; ytr <- sim$train$y
  Xte <- sim$test$X;  yte <- sim$test$y
  bstar <- sim$beta

  b_cp  <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "Cp")
  b_aic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "AIC")
  b_bic <- getBestSubset(Xtr, ytr, "BIC")

  one_row <- function(method_label, b_hat) {
    yhat <- pred(Xte, b_hat)
    sm   <- support_metrics(b_hat, bstar)
    tibble(
      method = method_label,
      mse    = mse(yte, yhat),
      err    = err(yte, yhat),
      acc    = sm$acc,
      sen    = sm$sen,
      spe    = sm$spe,
      n.p    = p / n.train,
      sigma2 = sigma2,
      simu   = i
    )
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    one_row("bestsubset_Cp",  b_cp),
    one_row("bestsubset_AIC", b_aic),
    one_row("bestsubset_BIC", b_bic)
  )
}

```
